archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) accents
brand_mission: Find your trail. Leave no trace.
visual_style: Futuristic, cinematic, premium travel-tech startup, dark mode, glassmorphism cards, glowing trail lines.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00F0FF] text-[#050907] font-medium px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-white transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: border border-[#E8E1D5]/20 backdrop-blur-md text-[#E8E1D5] px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-[#E8E1D5]/10 transition-all duration-300

cards.glass: bg-[#0E2419]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#E8E1D5]/10 rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] relative overflow-hidden
cards.metric: bg-[#050907] border-l-2 border-[#00F0FF] p-6 rounded-r-xl shadow-lg

badges.sustainability: bg-[#1B3B2E] text-[#E8E1D5] text-xs font-mono px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-[#E8E1D5]/20 inline-flex items-center gap-2
badges.weather: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md text-white text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-white/10 inline-flex items-center gap-2

map.style: SVG stylized Greece map. Stroke color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1), Glowing trail lines: #00F0FF with drop-shadow glow. Clickable pins with pulse animation.

trail_cards.title: Pindus Mountain Path
trail_cards.description: Misty stone hiking path in ancient forest.

trail_cards.title: Peloponnese Coastal Route
trail_cards.description: Hidden coastal trail overlooking the sea.

trail_cards.title: Deep Forest Waterfall
trail_cards.description: Serene hidden waterfall in dark green forest.

hero.layout: Min-h-screen, center aligned or split layout. Overlay hero_bg image with a heavy bg-gradient-to-r from-[#050907]/90 via-[#050907]/60 to-transparent for text contrast.
hero.content: Headline: 'Discover the Greece nobody else sees.' Subheadline: 'An AI trail companion that matches you with sustainable outdoor experiences across Greece.' Buttons: 'Start Your Journey' (Primary) and 'Explore Hidden Trails' (Secondary).
hero.visuals: Right side should feature a stylized glowing SVG Map of Greece with pulsating trail pins in electric cyan. Float small glassmorphic weather/crowd badges around the map.

problem_overtourism.content: Tell the data story: 36M+ tourists, highly concentrated. Emphasize hidden trails vs crowded spots.
problem_overtourism.visuals: Use grayscale overtourism photos tinted with dark forest green. Large typography for metrics.

how_it_works.layout: 4-step timeline layout connected by a 'Tracing Beam' - a glowing cyan line animation.
how_it_works.content: 1. Conversational AI Intake 2. Personalized Trail Matching 3. Sustainability Intelligence 4. Real-Time Adaptation.

ai_chat_mockup.layout: Container with ai_chat_bg heavily blurred (backdrop-blur-3xl). Center the chat interface like a floating Apple Messages mockup but in dark mode glassmorphism.
ai_chat_mockup.content: Show realistic user message (Easy/moderate near sea). AI reply with a trail card from media.trail_cards, map snippet, duration, weather, and a sustainability score badge.

itinerary.layout: Grid split: Visuals left, Day plan right.
itinerary.visuals: Use Recharts for an elevation graph (stroke='#00F0FF', fill='url(#colorUv)' with a green-to-transparent gradient). Include a sleek weather timeline.

sustainability.layout: Full width banner or large card using sustainability_bg with a dark overlay.
sustainability.content: Display: Crowd Reduction Score, Community Support Index, Trail Preservation Status, Low-Impact Travel Tips.

advanced_ai.layout: 3-column grid of glassmorphism cards using the 'Neumorphism' tactile variant (sharp inner contrasts).
advanced_ai.content: Real-Time Trail Condition Agent, Photo-to-Trail Matching, Dynamic Itinerary Adaptation.

cta.content: Headline: 'The future of tourism is not more travelers. It is smarter journeys.' Primary button: 'Find Your Trail'.

technical_rules.accessibility: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Contrast ratios must meet APCA standards.
technical_rules.components: Use custom HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout (sections, asymmetric grids). Use Shadcn/UI primitives heavily customized (no standard vercel look) for complex interactive elements.
technical_rules.motion: Use framer-motion for staggering lists, hover states, and smooth scroll reveals. Use 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling.
